label: Chapter 8
title: Beyond the post, toward the whole site
dek: Once a paragraph could be a block, so could a header, a footer, a menu — and then the design of the whole site.

blocks.text: The block editor changed how a post was written. It left the header, the footer and the page templates where they had always been: in a theme’s PHP files.

blocks: Phase two set out to close that gap, in instalments: patterns — ready-made arrangements of blocks — in 2020;[^wp55] block-editable templates and `theme.json`, one file for a theme’s colours and type, in 2021;[^wp58] and on 25 January 2022, WordPress 5.9: “Full site editing is here.”[^wp59]

blocks.name: siteScene
blocks.caption: The Site Editor, redrawn and simplified. The order of events is accurate; the screen is a reconstruction, not a screenshot.

steps.label: 2018 · the post
steps.text: With 5.0, what can be edited as blocks is the content of a single post. The header above it and the footer below belong to the theme’s code.

steps.label: 2020–21 · patterns and templates
steps.text: Patterns arrive in 5.5. In 5.8, the template that surrounds a post can itself be opened in the block editor.[^wp58]

steps.label: 2022 · the whole site
steps.text: In 5.9 the Site Editor opens everything. Header and footer become “template parts” made of blocks, and Twenty Twenty-Two is “the first default block theme in the history of WordPress.”[^wp59]

steps.label: Styles
steps.text: One panel changes colour and type everywhere at once. From 6.0, a theme can ship several complete looks, called style variations.[^wp60]

blocks.name: variations
blocks.caption: Four invented style variations for one block theme. The post has not changed since 2003.

blocks: It took longer than planned. Version 5.9 slipped six weeks,[^wp59-delay] and the Site Editor wore a “beta” label until March 2023.[^wp62] Theme authors had already said the pace was hard to keep up with: “There is some broken trust between theme authors and WordPress at the moment,” Justin Tadlock wrote in 2020.[^tadlock-2020]

Other things were built in these years. Openverse, a search engine for openly licensed images, joined the project.[^openverse] WordPress 5.6 came “from an all-women and non-binary identifying release squad.”[^wp56] And Adam Zieliński got all of WordPress running inside a browser tab with no server behind it — the experiment that became Playground.[^playground]
On 27 May 2023 the project marked twenty years since its first release.[^wp20-birthday] That August, version 6.3 was declared “the capstone of Phase 2.”[^wp63]

blocks.title: A short glossary, from the documentation

rows: “Everything from a paragraph, to a video, to the site title is represented as a block.”[^key-concepts]
“…a group of blocks that have been combined together creating a design pattern.”[^key-concepts]
One of the “reusable areas within a template, including semantic areas like header, sidebar, and footer.”[^key-concepts]
“…a configuration file that lets you define the global settings, styles, and more for your theme.”[^theme-json]
“In a way, they are ‘skins’ for your theme.”[^style-variations]
The name settled on in November 2022 for what had been called full site editing.[^site-editor-name]

items.text: This early demo runs a full WordPress directly in the browser without a PHP server! While it isn’t fully stable yet, it is a major breakthrough that could transform learning, contributing, and using WordPress.

How it works, in his words: “PHP is compiled to WASM,” the code and files are bundled up, and a service worker “traps HTTP requests and re-routes them to WordPress.”[^playground] The project was renamed WordPress Playground in December 2022.[^playground-rename] By August 2026 it could start up WordPress from any era, back to 0.7 — the release described in chapter 1.[^playground-eras]

blocks.title: A community that could not meet

items.text: The first WordCamp Asia, due to open in Bangkok nine days later, is cancelled over COVID-19.[^wcasia-2020]
Learn WordPress is announced: workshops, courses and lesson plans online.[^learn]
WordCamp Asia is finally held, in Bangkok, three years late.[^wc-past]
